result_text:
I fixed the per-rep purchase-order count so it no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` and `DemoScenarioTest` pass. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case or run Anna and Bob's example.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `DataStore.java`. The subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the per-quarter purchase-order report uses. I also updated the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled".

The ordering and the zero-count rows for reps without purchase orders are untouched. I didn't commit.
